title: Adaptive Micro-Practice
changes: Added Adaptive Micro-Practice for repeatedly missed word × skill combinations.
A single short Listening Station, Campfire-style recall, Theatre-style context or meaning repair card can be inserted into the lesson flow.
One ordinary mistake does not trigger an intervention; difficulty scores persist and interventions have a cooldown.
Successful micro-practice reduces the stored difficulty score.
Fixed the squashed Sensei portrait by preserving its aspect ratio and enlarging its frame.
Added shorter, friendlier Sensei zero-state wording.
Reduced mobile Journey/Japan Ready neighbouring-card intrusion while retaining the swipe cue.
Retains all v11.7.x summary, touch, Kana overlay, Keep Learning and performance improvements.
Bumped release and cache references to v11.8.0.
